data.summary: Replacement foundation review at exact tip 9af9fc1533b681335f37700738a8dc1a93c89054. In addition to closing every mandatory c-reviewer:2 finding, a rotated local adversarial pass found and this tip fixes two high issues: ExecutionPrefix no longer requires a pre-existing completion, so every admitted finite Runs branch is observable, while ProgramBehavior.Adequate separately requires a finite-terminal or infinite continuation from every finite frontier; and the trust command now audits every non-internal declaration originating in Grass, Tests, or the invoking module, so a VerifiedProgram hidden in a container or consumed by a ByteArray-producing definition cannot evade the audit. Negative probes cover irreducible aliases and wrapped producers. The same pass found and closed overclaims in README, StableId.render, and CONTRIBUTING; its closure review returned no findings, but does not count as merge review. Please review this commit rather than withdrawn g-foundation:20.
